# Brannen circulant is the forced C3-covariant record-preserving generation form

**Date:** 2026-06-15
**Type:** bounded theorem
**Claim type:** bounded_theorem
**Status:** source note awaiting independent audit handling.
**Primary runner:** [`scripts/frontier_brannen_circulant_forced_c3_covariant_form_2026_06_15.py`](../scripts/frontier_brannen_circulant_forced_c3_covariant_form_2026_06_15.py)
**Cached output:** not generated by this source note; reviewer caching should use [`scripts/frontier_brannen_circulant_forced_c3_covariant_form_2026_06_15.py`](../scripts/frontier_brannen_circulant_forced_c3_covariant_form_2026_06_15.py).

## Claim
On the supplied C3[111] generation 3-space, a local Hermitian generator commuting
with the [111] 3-fold rotation `C`, namely `[H,C]=0`, has the circulant form
`H = a I + b C + conj(b) C^T`. This is the Brannen form. It has exactly three
real couplings, written as `(a, |b|, delta)`, and is non-demolition for the
supplied einselected pointer `S = C + C^2`. In this theorem, the C3[111]
generation action and pointer are inputs, and the couplings `(a, |b|, delta)`
are the supplied sector dial.

## Derivation
The runner builds the real 9-dimensional Hermitian basis and computes the commutator map
`H -> [H,C]` by an exact rank/nullspace calculation on that basis. The nullity is required to be exactly
`3`. If the nullity were `9`, C3 covariance would not force the form; if it were `1`, it would over-force
the sector to scalars. The runner then reconstructs every computed commuting Hermitian basis vector,
and general real combinations of them, as `a I + b C + conj(b) C^T`. This establishes the commutant as
the circulant algebra, not merely as an abstract 3-real-dimensional space.

Locality on the generation 3-cycle supplies the range-`<=1` displacement
operators `{I, C, C^2}`. Their span is the C3-covariant local algebra, and
Hermiticity restricts the coefficients to `a in R` and paired coefficients
`b, conj(b)`, giving the Brannen form. The two-sector pointer is preserved
because every Brannen-form `H` commutes with `S = C + C^2`, whose spectrum is
`{2, -1, -1}`. This is the generation-space analog of the context-only gauge
mechanism named below.

## Significance
This upgrades the Brannen circulant from an explicit bounded classification
premise to the forced form inside the supplied C3-covariant generation context.
The only remaining freedom is the three real couplings:
`a`, `|b|`, and `delta`. Equivalently, the Brannen FORM is forced; the couplings are the dial.

## Boundary
The FORM is forced by the supplied C3[111] generation action plus locality and
Hermiticity. The COUPLINGS `(a, |b|, delta)` are not forced. This note does NOT
derive delta, does NOT force r=1/2, and does not supply the within-sector
measure. The open next stage is the relaxation or coupling-determination target
that would explain which sector dial values are selected. The [111]-C3
generation action and the einselected pointer input are assumed here.
